rccg_open_heavens.title: SHIELD OTHER CHILDREN
rccg_open_heavens.author: Pastor E.A. Adeboye
rccg_open_heavens.memoryVerseText: Let the sighing of the prisoner come before thee; according to the greatness of thy power preserve thou those that are appointed to die;
message: In 1982, the year after I became the General Overseer of The Redeemed Christian Church of God, my wife, who was teaching at the small school we had started at the church's headquarters in Ebute Metta, Lagos State, asked if I could assist her in the school. She felt that since I had become a full-time pastor, my help would go a long way. In that school, nobody was paying any fees. Those who attended the school were children of church members who wanted a secure place for their children to stay while they were away at work. We had a small bus at that time to transport those children from their various homes to school every morning.

One morning, the bus had gone to pick up the children and was returning to the school when it was caught in the midst of an armed robbery operation in Oyingbo, a community in Ebute Metta. Gunshots were fired, and a stray bullet hit one of the pupils inside the bus. The bullet passed through the child's body and brought out his intestines as it created an exit wound. To cut a long story short, the driver turned back and started heading towards the Lagos University Teaching Hospital (LUTH). There was heavy traffic on the road, so it took them approximately two hours to reach LUTH. When they got to the hospital, the doctors looked at the boy, saw the amount of blood he had lost, and concluded that there was no need to waste time on him. They were certain that there was nothing that could be done to save the boy, so they didn't bother to attend to him. However, the school helpers, who were also on the school bus, and other people with them did not stop praying for the boy.

One hour later, a doctor said, "This boy is still breathing. Let us do something, even if all we have to do is stitch him up." So, they took him into the theatre, removed the bullet, stitched him up, and waited for him to die. To the glory of God, that child has now become an adult, and he is still alive today!

Beloved, make it a duty to pray for other people's children. Let God use you to save someone's child through prayer. Rather than complain about the bad character of some of the children around you, get on your knees and pray for them to be well-behaved and God fearing.
prayerPoints: Action Point: Commit to praying for the children around you.
rccg_open_heavens.hymn: I want to be like Jesus

rccg_open_heavens.title: YOUR DIVINE IDENTITY
rccg_open_heavens.author: Pastor E.A. Adeboye
rccg_open_heavens.memoryVerseText: Depart ye, depart ye, go ye out from thence, touch no unclean thing; go ye out of the midst of her; be ye clean, that bear the vessels of the LORD.
message:
There was a story of an eagle that a mother hen hatched. For years, the eagle behaved like a chicken — scratching for worms and never soaring as an eagle should. That continued until one day, the eagle saw another eagle flying in the sky and was intrigued by the way it spread its wings and soared in the sky. Somehow, the eagle felt it could also do the same thing; so it opened up its wings and began to fly. That was when the eagle realised that it was not a chicken, but an eagle that was born to soar.
Beloved, if you don’t recognise your identity in Christ, you will remain a slave to the things Jesus went to the cross to deliver you from. You will struggle for worms with other chickens when you should be soaring high in the sky and diving to get your meals without struggling. Knowing your divine identity will empower you to overcome whatever struggles you face, as you will understand that Jesus has paid the price for you to be free.
You cannot know who you are in God if you don’t spend time in His word. Your divine identity can only be revealed to you through God’s word. The more you spend time reading and studying God’s word, the more His light will shine upon your heart to show you who you are in Him. Psalm 119:130 says that the entrance of God’s word gives light and understanding to the simple. It doesn’t matter your background or status; once you come to Christ, you have become royalty. Revelation 1:6 says that Jesus has made us kings and priests unto God and His Father. Today’s Bible reading also reveals that if you are a child of God, you are royalty.
Beloved, you are God’s chosen vessel and an ambassador for Christ (2 Corinthians 5:20). This means that there are things you cannot do, and one of them is to live in sin. Today’s memory verse says that we should keep ourselves clean because we bear the vessels of the Lord. If you bear the vessels of the Lord, no unclean thing should be found in you. You must steer clear of anything that represents sin and unrighteousness. Princes should not be found naked in public. Sin makes people naked, and your divine identity as a royal priesthood forbids this.
prayerPoints: Reflection:
Do you know and walk in your divine identity?
rccg_open_heavens.hymn: Hymn 7: I Am Thine O Lord

rccg_open_heavens.title: FLEE LUSTS
rccg_open_heavens.author: Pastor E.A. Adeboye
rccg_open_heavens.memoryVerseText: But thou, O man of God, flee these things; and follow after righteousness, godliness, faith, love, patience, meekness.
message: The Bible says that you should resist the devil, and he will flee from you (James 4:7). Elijah is one character in the Bible who really exemplified this principle of resisting the devil. He stood against everyone who opposed God, including the king and all the prophets of Baal. However, when a woman, Jezebel, decided to go after him, he did not stand to resist her; rather, he fled. When the devil decides to tempt you with a member of the opposite sex, don't stand and fight; flee!

In 2 Timothy 2:22, the Bible says, “Flee youthful lusts.” Child of God, when it comes to sexual temptation, don't fight it; instead, run! Always warn my male children, “don't stand in Jesus' name.” However, if a lady approaches them smiling seductively, they are the ones who must flee from lust, because you cannot win that battle by fighting it; you can only win it by fleeing. If you are a man and you find yourself being seduced by a lady, you must flee. It does not matter how anointed you are; run fast! The anointing does not turn the body to stone. rccg_open_heavens.title: NO MORE FAILURE!
rccg_open_heavens.author: Pastor E.A. Adeboye
rccg_open_heavens.memoryVerseText: But thanks be to God, which giveth us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.
message:
There was a man who always faced setbacks. Every time he was close to having a breakthrough, something would truncate his plans. Each time he had won a big contract and was informed that the contract had been awarded to another bidder, he was instructed to collect his award letter in a plane and headed to Abuja. Unknown to him, the person in charge of the contract had changed his mind and given the contract to someone else. After receiving this news upon his arrival in Abuja, the man decided that he couldn't bear it anymore. He surrendered his life to Jesus, and prayed for him. The Lord had mercy on him, broke the yoke of failure in his life, and from then on, he began to record one breakthrough after another.
Beloved, God wants you to live in victory in all areas of your life. He also wants you to move from one level of success to another. Proverbs 4:18 says, "But the path of the just is as the shining light, that shineth more and more unto the perfect day." While following Jesus doesn't exempt you from challenges, God's plan is not for you to live under the shadow of defeat and failure.
I once met a boy who consistently failed all his exams, despite his parents being professors. If he moved from a class of 30 pupils to a class of 35 pupils, his position would move from 30th to 35th; he just couldn't help it. His parents got him the best private tutors, yet he continued to fail. One day, his parents brought him to me, and we prayed together. The next examination was scheduled, so he came first among his peers. The teachers were shocked, so he was asked to retake the examination. Surprisingly, he scored even higher than he did in his first attempt. Since then, failure has been banished from his life.
Beloved, are you experiencing recurring failure? If you are already born again or if you surrender your life to Jesus now, I will deliver good news for you: the Lord is more than able to deliver you from the cycle of failure. Call on Him for help today, and He will deliver you. He will show you what you must do to start succeeding, and as you do it, you will never know failure again.
prayerPoints: Prayer Point: I decree that I will no longer experience failure and defeat in any area of my life, in Jesus' name.

rccg_open_heavens.title: ALWAYS SEEK HIS HELP
rccg_open_heavens.author: Pastor E.A. Adeboye
rccg_open_heavens.memoryVerseText: In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.
message:
I recall a time when my father was sitting in an armchair in front of the house, taking in the fresh air. I was also outside, playing football. Suddenly, I kicked the ball high, and it landed on the roof of the house. The roof of the house was thatched, so when the ball landed, it just stayed there. I then went to get a long stick to dislodge the ball from the roof. However, each time I tried to bring the ball down, it kept moving back, and I couldn't see it because I was still a young boy with a small stature. After going at it for a while, I got tired. Then, I went to my father and said, "Daddy, please help me; my ball is on the roof." My father then said, "You saw me sitting here, but you thought you could do it on your own". Then, he got up and, in one attempt, he brought the ball down.
Beloved, if you do things your own way, God will not interfere in your matters. He doesn't force Himself on people; He only helps those who genuinely need help and ask for it. The popular saying that heaven helps those who help themselves doesn't apply to God. It is a worldly slogan because God only helps those who are genuinely in need and humbly approach Him for help. Psalm 34:6 says:
This poor man cried, and the LORD heard him, and saved him out of all his troubles.
Someone who is poor is genuinely in need of something. Such a person acknowledges God as the only One who can help him or her. In Revelation 3:14-17, the Lord scolded the Laodicean church for calling themselves rich when, indeed, they were poor, wretched, and blind. Those who think they can do it all by themselves are living in deceit. God will fold His arms and watch them struggle, and until they cry to Him for help, they will keep running around in circles. When babies stretch out their arms, it means that they are ready to be carried.
Beloved, open your arms wide today, and let God carry you. Involve Him in all you do so that you will not struggle to do the things He can help you do with ease.
prayerPoints: Prayer Point:
Dear Lord, please take control of every area of my life and grant me ease in all that I do.

rccg_open_heavens.title: FERVENT PRAYERS
rccg_open_heavens.author: PASTOR E.A ADEBOYE
rccg_open_heavens.memoryVerseText: But if from thence thou shalt seek the LORD thy God, thou shalt find him, if thou seek him with all thy heart and with all thy soul.
message:
There are different kinds of prayers, but often, the way people pray reveals the depth of their longing and how urgently they desire God's intervention. Imagine a case where two critically injured people are in a hospital, and one says, "Oh, doctor, come and help me treat this wound," and then brings out his or her phone to watch cartoons. Then, the other fellow screams out, "Doctor, I am in serious pain. Help me now!" Who do you think the doctor will attend to first? Definitely, the doctor will first attend to the one who screamed out loud for help.
Many people come to God's presence casually, speaking 'Queen's English', with 'steeze and composure', as the youths would say. However, some other people pray to God with their whole heart and strength, and, like Jacob in Genesis 32:26, they say, "Lord, I will not let You go unless You bless me!"
Sometimes, my friends abroad ask me why we experience so many miracles in Africa, while there are very few in the so-called civilised world. I tell them that it is simply because they believe that they have alternatives. When a person has no one else to talk to apart from God, he or she will know how to pray fervently. Also, if a fellow has an illness that has defied all forms of treatment, such a fellow will understand what it means to pray fervently.
James 5:16 says that the effectual fervent prayers of the righteous avail much. In today's Bible reading, when the Canaanite woman asked Jesus to deliver her demon-possessed daughter, she cried unto Him, saying, "Have mercy on me, O Lord, thou Son of David." That woman was not casual about her prayers; she kept crying out to Jesus until she received a response. Likewise, in Mark 10:46-52, blind Bartimaeus cried out to Jesus with a loud voice, "Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me." All attempts by people to shut him up proved unsuccessful, as he continued to call out to Jesus for help. Eventually, Jesus heard him, and he got his miracle.
Beloved, if anything is troubling you, cry unto God today with all your heart and soul, and He will hear you. Call upon Him with all your strength and humility, and He will grant your requests. He will, however, not listen to the prayers of a sinner who has refused to repent and forsake his or her sins (Isaiah 59:1-2).

open_heavens.title: FERVENT PRAYERS
open_heavens.author: PASTOR E.A ADEBOYE
open_heavens.memoryVerseText: But if from thence thou shalt seek the LORD thy God, thou shalt find him, if thou seek him with all thy heart and with all thy soul.
message:
There are different kinds of prayers, but often, the way people pray reveals the depth of their longing and how urgently they desire God's intervention. Imagine a case where two critically injured people are in a hospital, and one says, "Oh, doctor, come and help me treat this wound," and then brings out his or her phone to watch cartoons. Then, the other fellow screams out, "Doctor, I am in serious pain. Help me now!" Who do you think the doctor will attend to first? Definitely, the doctor will first attend to the one who screamed out loud for help.
Many people come to God's presence casually, speaking 'Queen's English', with 'steeze and composure', as the youths would say. However, some other people pray to God with their whole heart and strength, and, like Jacob in Genesis 32:26, they say, "Lord, I will not let You go unless You bless me!"
Sometimes, my friends abroad ask me why we experience so many miracles in Africa, while there are very few in the so-called civilised world. I tell them that it is simply because they believe that they have alternatives. When a person has no one else to talk to apart from God, he or she will know how to pray fervently. Also, if a fellow has an illness that has defied all forms of treatment, such a fellow will understand what it means to pray fervently.
James 5:16 says that the effectual fervent prayers of the righteous avail much. In today's Bible reading, when the Canaanite woman asked Jesus to deliver her demon-possessed daughter, she cried unto Him, saying, "Have mercy on me, O Lord, thou Son of David." That woman was not casual about her prayers; she kept crying out to Jesus until she received a response. Likewise, in Mark 10:46-52, blind Bartimaeus cried out to Jesus with a loud voice, "Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me." All attempts by people to shut him up proved unsuccessful, as he continued to call out to Jesus for help. Eventually, Jesus heard him, and he got his miracle.
Beloved, if anything is troubling you, cry unto God today with all your heart and soul, and He will hear you. Call upon Him with all your strength and humility, and He will grant your requests. He will, however, not listen to the prayers of a sinner who has refused to repent and forsake his or her sins (Isaiah 59:1-2).

rccg_open_heavens.title: HELP FROM HEAVEN 1
rccg_open_heavens.author: PASTOR E.A ADEBOYE
rccg_open_heavens.memoryVerseText: The angel of the LORD encampeth round about them that fear him, and delivereth them.
message:
A person who fears God will always enjoy assistance from heaven. When I talk about enjoying assistance from heaven, it includes receiving help from beings who live in heaven, specifically the angels.
Today's memory verse tells us that the angel of the Lord encamps around those who fear Him and delivers them. You can be certain of angelic interventions and rescues when you fear the Lord. Today's Bible reading refers to someone who fears the Lord as a blessed person. When you fear the Lord and delight greatly in His commandments, you will be blessed, and you can expect angels to intervene in your affairs.
In 1 Kings 19:4-8, when Elijah was so discouraged that he felt like dying, God sent an angel to him twice to strengthen him with food. Before this incident, he had confronted the prophets of Baal, burnt their altars, and killed them. He had purged the land of idolatry because he feared the Lord (1 Kings 18:1-40). In Daniel 6:19-22, an angel came and shut the mouths of lions so that they would not harm Daniel because he chose to obey God's commandments (Daniel 6:4-10). In 2 Kings 19:32-37, a single angel from the Lord fought against Sennacherib and destroyed 185,000 Assyrian soldiers in one night. This was because King Hezekiah was a blessed man who feared the Lord (2 Kings 19:14-19). In Matthew 2:13-15, an angel warned Joseph in a dream that Herod was seeking to kill Jesus. In Acts 12:5-11, an angel came to set Peter free from prison the night before he was to be killed. Every one of these people experienced angelic interventions because they feared God.
A lady once shared her experience during a flight when the aircraft encountered turbulence, and it appeared as if it was going to crash. As she cried out to God for help, she looked out of the window and saw an angel smiling at her as he carried the plane in the palm of his hand. Immediately, she stopped being anxious and became assured that there was nothing to worry about. I prophesy to you that God will send His angel to rescue you in turbulent times, in Jesus' name.
Beloved, when you fear the Lord and obey His commandments at all times, you can rest assured that the hosts of angels in heaven will come to your aid in times of need.
prayerPoints: Key Point:
Those who fear the Lord and delight greatly in His commandments will always enjoy help from heaven.
rccg_open_heavens.hymn: Hymn 27 What A Friend We Have In Jesus

sunday_school_lessons.author: RCCG Sunday School Directorate
sunday_school_lessons.memoryVerseText: And the very God of peace sanctify you wholly; and I pray God your whole spirit and soul and body be preserved blameless unto the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.
message:
A. The apostle Paul, while addressing the Church in Corinth on God’s Standard of righteousness, emphasised that it is through sanctification that they are qualified to inherit God’s Kingdom. He started by asking:
Know ye not? ………………………………. Vs. 9a.
B. He further identified some of the unrighteous that will not inherit God’s kingdom, namely: ………………………… Vs. 9b-10.
C. Reminding them that:

i. Such were some………………………. vs.11a.
ii. But ………………………….. Vs. 11b.
prayerPoints: Lord, guide my steps today.
sunday_school_lessons.hymn: O Sunday School, on the Lord’s day
sunday_school_lessons.assignments: List five (5) practical ways a believer can daily live a sanctified life (2×5=10 marks).
sunday_school_lessons.introduction: Sanctification is a spiritual surgery performed by God in the life of a saved soul (Ezekiel 36:26). It is the second work of grace after salvation. Sanctification simply means to make holy, pure and separated unto God (Jeremiah 1:4-5). It is a progressive work of God in man that makes us free from sin and be like Christ (1 Thessalonians 5:23; Romans 8:13). It is vital to understand the process and benefits of sanctification.
outlines: THE PROCESS
THE BENEFITS
sunday_school_lessons.discussion:
1. THE PROCESS

A. To be sanctified

You need to see yourself as you are: filthy and in need of help
Cry to God for deliverance (Isaiah 6:5).
Present yourself to the Sanctifier – God (1 Thessalonians 5:23).
Surrender your heart to the Holy Spirit (1 Peter 1:2; 2 Thessalonians 2:13).
Study the word of God (John 17:17).
Soak yourself in the blood of Jesus (Hebrews 9:13-14; 1 John 1:7, 9).
Daily surrender to God (Colossians 3:6-10; Romans 6:13).
B. This process can be a painful experience, but:

The result is that you are broken and transformed into a new nature (Galatians 2:20; 2 Timothy 2:3-4).
The awareness that you do not own yourself anymore helps you prioritise God in everything you do, and whatever does not glorify Him is a no-go area for you (1 Corinthians 6:19-20).
CLASS ACTIVITY 1: How do we avoid things that defile His Temple?

2. THE BENEFITS

Sanctification represents a believer’s victory over the flesh (Romans 7:24-25), the world (1 John 5:4), and the devil (James 4:7).
A sanctified believer will enjoy the ability to easily resist temptation because there is a renewed hatred for sin and lust.
Sanctification fosters intimacy with God, increases spiritual strength and stability (Psalm 15:1-5).
It also aids a ‘clean record’ for believers, that is, the enemy will not have to fool God over such (John 14:30).
It helps believers to be humble and submissive to God and to constituted authorities. The Adamic nature in man is subdued (Romans 8:1-5).
It gives the believer control over self (Galatians 2:20; Romans 6:13).
It promotes right standing before God and pure intentions of actions and words (Acts 24:16).
CLASS ACTIVITY 2: The class should discuss the ways sanctification helps a believer to live a life that honours God.
sunday_school_lessons.summary:
CONCLUSION: Sanctification is an integral part of Christian growth; every child of God must earnestly desire it.

EVALUATION: Briefly explain the process of sanctification.

CLOSING PRAYER: Father, I receive the grace to continually yield myself to your sanctification process in Jesus’ name.

It helps believers to be humble and submissive to God and to constituted authorities. The Adamic nature in man is subdued (Romans 8:1-5).
It gives the believer control over self (Galatians 2:20; Romans 6:13).
It promotes right standing before God and pure intentions of actions and words (Acts 24:16).
CLASS ACTIVITY 2: The class should discuss the ways sanctification helps a believer to live a life that honours God.

sunday_school_lessons.author: Pastor Chris Oyakhilome
sunday_school_lessons.topic: The Word—Your True Life And Environment
sunday_school_lessons.memoryVerseText: Forasmuch as ye are manifestly declared to be the epistle of Christ…
message: 1 Peter 1:23 tells us something remarkable; it says, “Being born again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, by the word of God, which liveth and abideth for ever.” A similar truth is emphasized in James 1:18, “Of his own will begat he us with the word of truth, that we should be a kind of firstfruits of his creatures.” God’s Word gave birth to you; and what does that make you?

It means you’re the Word in flesh! The Word of God is your life-source, and every living thing must be connected to its source to live. This is why your fellowship with the Word is so important. Your true life and environment are in the Word. If you live outside the Word, you’re functioning outside your divine environment.

The Apostle Paul, by the Spirit, connects and unveils this beautifully in 2 Corinthians 3:2-3. First, he says, “Ye are our epistle…” and then he goes further to say, “…ye are manifestly declared to be the epistle of Christ…” You’re the living epistle, the living message, the living expression of Christ to your world. The Lord Jesus is called the living Word; therefore, being born of His Word, you carry His life, nature, wisdom and character within you.

You’re indestructible because you’re born of His indestructible seed (His Word), which lives and abides forever. Therefore, your sufficiency, your ability, competence, strength and capacity come from your divine origin. Many struggle in life because they don’t live according to this truth. They attempt to live outside the environment of the Word.

But the Christian who meditates on the Word continually stays connected to the source of his divine nature. The more the Word dominates your spirit, the more your true nature is unveiled. God’s Word created the universe. His Word is everything. As you meditate on it, it transforms your life. Think, speak, and live the Word. Glory to God!
prayerPoints: Lord, guide my steps today.
